themes.title: Electoral Volatility and Internal Friction Facing Right-Wing Parties
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist movements across borders are experiencing sharply divergent electoral fortunes and internal discord. While Sweden's Sweden Democrats face unexpected local election setbacks and the US MAGA coalition contends with intra-party rebellion over war policy, Norway's Progress Party is soaring to historic poll leads that upset established coalition dynamics.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Suffered widespread losses across 285 of 290 municipalities, sparking debate over party factions and strategy.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Surged to 32.5% in polls, creating tension with former senior coalition partner Høyre over leadership of the right.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Confronts internal party revolt as Rep. Thomas Massie forces a House impeachment vote against Defense Secretary Hegseth.

themes.title: Populist Economic Relief Promises and Tax Cuts Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing and populist figures across multiple nations are advancing targeted economic proposals and spending reforms to appeal to voters facing living costs. These measures range from wealth tax proposals in Norway and targeted retiree tax relief in the US to social housing quota rollbacks in France.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes cutting wealth taxes while debating corporate tax levels, drawing pushback from conservative allies.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Advances major tax and deduction reforms alongside regulatory rollbacks targeting energy and industry.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen calls for abrogating mandatory municipal social housing quotas under the SRU law.

themes.title: Right-Wing Mainstreaming and Power Consolidation Ahead of Key Elections
themes.blurb: Populist right parties continue attempting to solidify their standing as primary conservative forces capable of leading national governments. While Norway's FrP successfully asserts dominance over traditional right-wing allies, parties in Sweden and France refine their platforms to demonstrate governing readiness.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Positioning party leader Sylvi Listhaug to claim the prime ministership after doubling the Conservative party in polls.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Evaluates its governing role within the broader right-wing bloc following municipal election drops.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Proposes major housing policy overhauls to demonstrate active legislative leadership.
